title: [Global Navigation] The brand logo image actually loads (not a broken-image placeholder)

requirement_ref.quote: The top-left brand logo fails to load properly, displaying a broken image placeholder icon in the browser viewport.

summary: Verify the brand logo image loads in the top navigation bar. The application did not behave as the requirement describes. A deterministic replay reproduced it identically, so this is not flakiness.
preconditions: Application is loaded at the home page
expected: The brand logo image actually loads (not a broken-image placeholder).
actual:
naturalWidth=0, src=https://buggyqa.vercel.app/broken-logo.png

Image did not load (naturalWidth=0). The element is present but the image data is missing — a broken-image placeholder. src: https://buggyqa.vercel.app/broken-logo.png

rationale: The flow completed and 1 critical assertion(s) did not hold: A1.
Every action the agent performed succeeded, so the failure is in the outcome, not the operation.
A deterministic replay failed the same way.
